# Welcome to Typeface’s Trust and Compliance Program

At Typeface, trust is woven into the fabric of everything we do. To keep your data safe and private, we deploy **industry-leading safeguards** for security and to manage our systems. To earn your trust, we make it a point to transparently share our security and compliance program with you. Please reach out to us at security@typeface.ai with any questions.

Looking for something specific? Search across Typeface’s security, trust, and compliance program

5

### Certifications

![Certification Logo](https://trust.typeface.ai/static/soc2-type1-badge-BrQMGx8A.png)

###### SOC 2 Type I · 1

Typeface has successfully completed a Service Organization Control 2 (SOC 2) Type I audit of our control environment via an independent assessment by a certified auditor.

![Certification Logo](https://trust.typeface.ai/static/soc2-type2-badge-C-UTZIDZ.png)

###### SOC 2 Type II · 1

Typeface has successfully completed a Service Organization Control 2 (SOC 2) Type II audit of our control environment via an independent assessment by a certified auditor.

![Certification Logo](https://trust.typeface.ai/static/iso27001-badge-simple-DngLMVSH.png)

###### ISO 27001 · 1

Typeface has successfully completed an ISO 27001 audit of our Information Security Management System (ISMS) via an independent assessment by a certified auditor.

![Certification Logo](https://trust.typeface.ai/static/iso42001-badge-h_eFF0SM.png)

###### ISO 42001 · 1

Typeface has successfully completed establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS) that meets the requirements of ISO/IEC 42001 to govern the use of AI in its organization.

![Certification Logo](https://trust.typeface.ai/static/iso27701-badge-Cpv_tJ3U.png)

###### ISO 27701 · 1

Typeface has successfully completed an ISO 27701 audit, via an independent assessment by a certified auditor. Our certification demonstrates an adequate implementation of a Privacy Management System (PIMS).
